maintenance_led.reason: Mostly engineering, design, consulting and project delivery for new infrastructure and facilities; O&M contracts are a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Large share from government clients: transport agencies, water utilities, defense, national security, UK Parliament and public infrastructure programs.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically through project wins; acquisitions are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Project-based engineering and consulting services are procured per project, so clients can change firms between projects without major disruption.

notes: Public funding is judged from my knowledge of Jacobs' government-heavy client mix; the website text doesn't state it.
